study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative modelling of brain function abnormalities in complex pathology needs the whole brain

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Resting-state fMRI data from the UK Biobank (UKB) using the ICA-parcellation with 55 components.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Using FUNCOIN and UK Biobank resting-state fMRI data from 46,000 healthy subjects across training and testing sets

answer.UK Biobank: normative training (N=32,000), normative testing (N=14,000), and patient for clinical research (BD N=101, PD N=132)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The healthy cohort was split into training (32,000) and test (14,000) sets for model development and out-of-sample validation. Subjects with Bipolar Disorder (BD) and Parkinson's Disease (PD) were used as clinical groups for outlier detection.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: A large group of healthy subjects to train the model on (training data, N=32,000), a set of healthy subjects on which we test the out-of-sample performance of the model (test data, N=14,000), and a group of subjects with psychiatric or neurological diagnoses ... BD (N=101) and PD (N=132).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Results / Whole-brain normative modelling of FC

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The healthy sample (N=46,000) was partitioned into a training set (N=32,000) and an out-of-sample test set (N=14,000). This split was applied to both the proposed FUNCOIN model and the edgewise comparison model.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: training data, N=32,000), a set of healthy subjects on which we test the out-of-sample performance of the model (test data, N=14,000)
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Results / Whole-brain normative modelling of FC

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age range for the whole dataset is reported as 44.56 to 85.43 years. Mean and standard deviation for the healthy cohorts were not explicitly provided.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: the age variable was linearly transformed the interval [0,1], with 0 and 1 corresponding to the minimum and maximum age in the whole dataset (44.56 and 85.43 years).
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.location: Kobbersmed2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Model fitting

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Sex was used as a covariate in all models, but specific counts or percentages for females and males within the healthy normative samples were not reported.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: predict FC as a function of sex and age ... Sex was coded as a categorical variable with 0 denoting female, 1 denoting male.
